user.title: Charge point
user.description: Pick the sensor that holds the cumulative kWh meter reading of your charge point. For ERE this must be the MID-certified meter built into the charger. Sensors that look like a charger meter are listed first ({candidates} found); tick the box to choose from all energy sensors.

details.title: Report details
details.description: Everything on this page is optional. Adding the EAN code and serial number makes the report complete, but is not required to submit it to your ERE registration service. Leave out what you do not know or do not want on the report, and click Submit. You can add it later via Configure. What Home Assistant already knows about your charger has been filled in.

data_description.charger_serial: Shown on the charger's rating plate or in the manufacturer's app.
